claims: As of April 2, 2026, the Pittsburgh Pirates are finalizing a nine-year, $140 million contract extension with Konnor Griffin.
The contract extension has a term of 9 years.
The contract extension has a total value of $140 million.
The contract extension has an average annual value (AAV) of $15.55 million.
The deal is the largest contract ever given to a player with no MLB service time.
The deal surpasses previous records for pre-debut extensions.
The deal coincides with Konnor Griffin's promotion to the major league roster.
The deal breaks the franchise record for the Pittsburgh Pirates.
The deal exceeds the $106.75 million extension signed by Bryan Reynolds.
The deal is finalized upon Konnor Griffin's MLB debut.
The contract shatters the previous record for the largest guarantee for a player who has not yet played a game in MLB.
The contract prevents Konnor Griffin from hitting free agency earlier than six years.
